title: Branding My Slave Hypnosis
description:
Let me take you deep into a trance. A happy, mindless trance where I remind you that you belong to me. That you are my slave. That I am in control, and what I say, you do.

And there is no resisting that. If I want to brand you like cattle, I will. In fact, that’s what this hypnosis file is all about. Branding you, my slave. Claiming you as mine, all mine to use as I see fit. And good slaves obey. And good slaves accept their brand with pride.

CW: Includes a command to write on your body.
author: Mistress Calia
